title: Fluorescent In Vitro Model to Assess Invasion and Intracellular Maturation of Bd in A6 Cells
author: Elin Verbrugghe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ishuee

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium A
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum to obtain a final composition of 70 % L15, 20 % distilled water, and 10 % fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium B
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum to obtain a final composition of 40 % L15, 55 % distilled water, and 5 % fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Coat Coverslips with Collagen
steps.instruction: Place glass coverslips in a 24‑well tissue‑culture plate, add 200 µL rat‑tail collagen coating solution to each well, incubate at 37 °C for 2 h, aspirate the solution, rinse the coated surface twice with HBSS‑, and either use immediately or store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

steps.title: Seed A6 Cells
steps.instruction: Detach A6 cells with trypsin, centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, wash with 70 % HBSS‑, count cells, centrifuge again 5 min at 1500 rpm, resuspend in Cell Medium A to 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL, add 1 mL (10⁵ cells) to each collagen‑coated well, incubate 2 h at 26 °C, 5 % CO₂, then wash with 70 % HBSS+; cells are now ready for Bd exposure. Include a control well for microscopy monitoring.

steps.title: Infect A6 Cells with Bd
steps.instruction: Isolate Bd zoospores, spin 5 min at 3000 rpm (20 °C), discard supernatant, resuspend in Cell Medium B and count spores, dilute to 1 × 10⁶ spores/mL in Medium B, add 1 mL to each well (MOI = 10:1), incubate 2 h at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂, gently wash three times with 70 % HBSS+ to remove non‑adherent spores, then replace Medium B with Cell Medium A for the desired number of days at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂. Include a control well to monitor spore motility.

steps.title: Live‑Cell Stain Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Wash infected cells three times with 70 % HBSS+, add 1 mL Cell Medium A containing 3 µM CellTracker™ Green CMFDA, incubate 45 min at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂ (work in the dark).

steps.title: Stain Extracellular Bd
steps.instruction: Remove the CellTracker solution, wash with 70 % HBSS+, add 200 µL CalcoFluor White (10 µg/mL in Cell Medium A), incubate 10 min (dark), then wash three times with HBSS+.

steps.title: Fix and Immunostain Bd
steps.instruction: Fix cells with 0.5 mL 3 % paraformaldehyde for 10 min (dark), wash twice with 70 % HBSS+, permeabilize with 200 µL 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in 70 % HBSS+ at room temperature for 2 min, wash twice with 70 % HBSS+, incubate 1–1.5 h with primary anti‑chytrid rabbit antibody diluted 1/1000, wash three times with 70 % HBSS+, incubate 1 h with Alexa Fluor 568 goat anti‑rabbit IgG diluted 1/500, wash three times with 70 % HBSS+, mount coverslips with ProLong™ Gold antifade mountant, and analyse Bd‑A6 interactions by fluorescence microscopy.
